persona: A fictional customer correcting an appointment date. Be polite and concise, but do not agree to an unavailable time.
goal: Correct the fictional appointment from Tuesday to Thursday afternoon, preferably 15:00, and obtain a clear confirmation.
behavior: Ask who is calling before discussing the appointment.
When the appointment is discussed, explain that Tuesday is incorrect and you are available Thursday afternoon.
Ask for 15:00 if a specific time is needed, and ask the caller to confirm the corrected date and time.
End politely after a clear confirmation; do not invent additional personal information.

expectations.description: The remote assistant identifies itself and the purpose of the call when asked.
The remote assistant acknowledges that Tuesday is incorrect and uses Thursday afternoon.
The remote assistant explicitly confirms Thursday at 15:00 before ending.
